body: The Vector types are intentionally declared manually in C#, so these enums should still be hardcoded. Otherwise, generated API will use `int` instead of the enum types which is worse and also breaks compat.

Could the binding generator use the following API to generate this without hardcoding?

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/6206fd5764d99bfbec4e73377428560d3caa0d20/core/variant/variant.h#L800-L804

Also note that `Projection.Planes`, `Vector4.Axis`, and `Vector4i.Axis` are missing.
